hypothesis: A persistent no-gradient numerical relation memory can dynamically construct longer chain and conditional branch structures when externally verified contradictions exhaust its prior 216 three-hop hypotheses, then retain them across cold restore and generalize to held subjects. Active inquiry might reduce genuine source calls; exact symbolic synthesis may tie or win. Constructed grammar extensions are not autonomously invented primitives.

fresh_source.kind: public synthetic structural-family source; no Wikidata, official, sealed or reserved source
fresh_source.law_generator: Source-only fresh independent seeded permutation edges; CHAIN4/CHAIN5 are distinct length-4/5 compositions, GATE2 applies one of two distinct two-hop compositions based on public subject parity. Reject world-law functions expressible as any <=3-hop primitive chain and reject target-law functional collisions. Deterministic bounded rejection or fail fixture; never modify frozen generator after public outcome.
fresh_source.inquiry_subjects: 40 disjoint source-legal entity IDs from seeded permutation; remaining 24 held entities inaccessible to learner; source reveals only requested target endpoint after action.

learners.NUMERIC_GROW_ACTIVE: A persistent bounded signed-int32 support/contradiction memory; begin with existing 216 length-three proposals, expand structures using generic forward composition and branch construction after verified contradictions rule out the initial family; form candidate circuits from public graph only, never source oracle. At most 16384 proposals and 131072 learned support/contradiction bytes. Active select legal unqueried sources maximizing remaining program prediction disagreement with deterministic tie breaks.
learners.NUMERIC_GROW_PASSIVE: Identical writer, proposal capacity, verified feedback, cold restoration, fixed precommitted source-blind inquiry order.
learners.NUMERIC_FIXED3: Same evidence and numeric counters but no proposal expansion beyond original 216, negative control for structure growth.
learners.SYMBOLIC_ACTIVE: Independently implemented exact program-synthesis control under the SAME declared primitive/compose/branch grammar, legal source pool, source-response budget, and adaptive inquiry capability, no numeric synaptic memory. Must match or outperform where it can represent the laws.
learners.TRAINED_GRU_PASSIVE: Fully converged conventional supervised GRU sequence/state learner using the SAME 32 source observations as NUMERIC_GROW_PASSIVE and same visible graph, 64-state units, 3 fixed training seeds, Adam learning, up to 2000 epochs per case, predeclared convergence/loss checks, best TRAINING-only run; training budget and software must be finalized before first-use, never report advantage against an undertrained baseline.
learners.NO_UPDATE: No source-label-dependent writes, fixed source query order; falsification control.

primary_metrics: held causal endpoint accuracy with abstentions incorrect
percentage novel target function classes recovered as unique on all 64 subjects (not merely known grammar label)
active-vs-passive paired world effects and bootstrap 10000 worlds seed1200
checkpoint cold restoration and tamper rejection
interference/cross-world retention under bounded shared memory
wall time training + inference + inquiry, peak bytes and energy proxy
primary_decision: Development mechanism signal requires at full 384-edge graph, 16 verified source calls, >=60% held answer accuracy for NUMERIC_GROW_ACTIVE and >=15 absolute percentage points above NUMERIC_FIXED3, 95% paired-world bootstrap lower>0; no confident errors and cold integrity all pass. This is only structural growth within a supplied grammar. SCIENTIFIC_PASS needs separately authorized independent first-use and precommitted advantage against strongest exact symbolic and fully trained conventional controls with complete resource accounting and >=5pp improvement, 95% CI lower>0 on unfamiliar law families and cold/interference tests; none is claimed by this fixture.
negative_controls: Equivalent alternate grammars get identical answers => identifiability failure / abstain
Unseen relation family unsupported by supplied operators => reject confident inference
Broken hidden-source access or seed replay => invalid
Known exact symbolic parity or win => no uniquely native advantage
Training convergence failure => scientific comparison invalid, not direct-weight superiority
statistical_plan: Pair all 24 worlds; bootstrap worlds with replacement 10000 times, RNG 1200, both direction comparisons and raw counts; preregister effect size and confidence intervals. No post-result threshold or seed changes.
engineering: Freeze protocol FIRST and commit before implementation/source scoring; source-safe interface and focused tests, inherited 54/54, G29 generated atlas, Ubuntu and Windows final SHA qualification separately. No new scheduler/controller, no protected source, no native Yggdrasil main mutations, no merge/promotion; keep original WSP119 negative.
limitations: This proposal does NOT show emergent abstract operators or AGI. Generic composition and parity-branch operators are supplied; growth is dynamic proposal allocation, not spontaneous discovery of completely unknown computation. Source-only synthetic DEV and trained baseline qualification are separate gates.
